reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 pt-BR 本地化，属于界面体验改造：将 Web UI 文案进行葡萄牙语（巴西）翻译并在浏览器语言为葡语时自动激活。能力仅涉及客户端 UI 文字与语言选择行为，不涉及代码生成、测试执行或外部服务调用。仓库说明也明确提到存在部分固定文本未覆盖，表明定位为局部界面本地化补丁，而非完整功能性工具链扩展。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 pt-BR 本地化插件，用于将 Web 界面文本翻译为巴西葡萄牙语，并在葡语环境下自动激活对应语言。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness locale plugin that translates the web interface into Brazilian Portuguese and activates pt-BR language preference for Portuguese browser environments.

capabilities: Registro de dicionários de interface pt-BR para namespaces do runtime de locale do DeepSeek Harness.
Adição/seleção de pt-BR na lista de idiomas e ativação automática por idioma do navegador para a sessão web.
Fornecimento de texto localizado para menus/configurações/conversa/áreas da interface via plugin de cliente web.

reasons.code: README describes that the plugin translates Web UI sections (menus, settings, chat, sidebar, workspaces, subagents, workflows) and registers dictionaries via locale.register(ns, 'pt-BR', dict), then applies a bridge to make pt-BR selectable.
package.json declares DSH web client plugin settings (platform web, immediate injection) and patch-based bundle integration, indicating runtime UI integration on the client side.
Repository file list/readme identify lib/dicts.js as source translations and generated lib/client.js used as browser plugin bundle, confirming scope is localization artifacts.
